subject: Usage drift triage + staged uplift proposal (Q4 handoff)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@elara.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Usage drift triage + staged uplift proposal (Q4 handoff)

Hi Elena —

Quick recap from our side after the usage analytics review this morning: your monthly token spend is up ~38% vs. the committed run-rate over the last 6 weeks, driven primarily by an increase in message length and a higher fraction of p95 inference-heavy reranker calls. We flagged two operational risks: token drift (higher avg tokens/session) and short windows of peak concurrency that push you into burst pricing.

Attached is a short variance workbook (q4-usage-variance.xlsx) and a staged uplift proforma that models two paths:
- Conservative: +15% commit, no SLA change (keeps price stable, small monthly uplift)
- Staged uplift (recommended): +30% commit phased over 3 months + temporary burst credit bundle to smooth month-to-month spikes (reduces overage risk, preserves current p95 targets)

High-level ask: can you confirm whether procurement has flexibility to accept a phased-term amendment for Q1 start? If yes, we’ll schedule a 30-min handoff to walk the proforma and supply a DocuSign-ready addendum.

If there are specific performance or security records you need to sign off the change (p95 targets, audit logs), call that out and we’ll include them in the packet. Proposed times for a call: Thu 11/11 10:00am PT or Fri 11/12 9:30am PT.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

--
Attachment: q4-usage-variance.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: staged-uplift-proforma-v1.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Elena Park <elena@elara.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@elara.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Usage drift triage + staged uplift proposal (Q4 handoff)

Thanks Jonas — useful summary. A couple quick items from our side before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Latency: we've seen p95 increase from 220ms to ~360ms during the spikes you noted. We need confidence the staged uplift won't increase our p95 SLA exposure during rollouts.
2) Throughput proof: procurement will ask for a short report showing throughput and concurrent session headroom at the proposed commit levels (approx 1.4M tokens/day average, 4.2M tokens/day peak).
3) Security: we need a recent SOC 2 sample (audit logs for the last 30 days) for the security review alongside any contract addendum.

Procurement is looped in. We can do Fri 11/12 9:30am PT for the call. Please send an updated proforma that includes: expected latency impact (if any), burst credit pricing, and an implementation timeline.

Elena Park
Head of Product, Elara AI
elena@elara.ai

--

Jonas / Monica —

Internal quick notes before the call with Elara:
- Latency: ops reports that a +30% commit with a short dedicated burst lane for peak windows should reduce p95 spikes. We can model a temporary dedicated capacity window (2x concurrency cap for 2 hours/day) during the phased rollout.
- Pricing: recommend a 3-month phased commit: month1 +10%, month2 +10%, month3 +10% (total +30%). Offer a 20% discount on the burst credits bundle for the first 3 months (to incentivize migration to commit).
- Risk: if they want immediate SLA guarantee for p95, that's a premium add-on (we should price separately).

Suggested next steps for call: confirm procurement asks (throughput numbers + SOC 2), present proforma v2 with the dedicated burst window option, and propose the DocuSign addendum template (simple amendment — no changes to core T&Cs).

I’ll prepare a short slide with the dedicated window diagram and expected p95 delta; Ben, can you quick-run the proforma numbers to validate cost-to-serve at 1.4M avg / 4.2M peak?

Marissa

Elena — attaching the updated proforma (staged-uplift-proforma-v2.pdf) and a short throughput/latency note. Key changes:

- Phased commit: +10% / +10% / +10% over 3 months (start 2028-01-01).
- Dedicated burst window: 2x concurrency cap for 2 hours/day during month1 and month2. Expected operational effect: reduce observed p95 spikes by ~90% in our internal sims; ops has committed to an on-call runbook for the rollout.
- Pricing: 20% discount on burst credits for months 1–3; if they require an immediate p95 SLA guarantee as a contract change, that will be priced as a separate SLA amendment (we've included a redline note in the proforma).

Call confirmed: Fri 12 Nov 2027 9:30am PT (added to calendar). I included Ben to validate the cost math — Ben, can you confirm numbers in v2?

Next steps for the call:
1) Walk the proforma & dedicated burst diagram (Marissa)
2) Validate throughput math & impact (Ben)
3) Confirm procurement items: SOC 2 audit logs and a short 2-page throughput summary (Jonas to own delivery by 11/11 EOD)

Thanks,
Jonas
